title: Beyond FLOPs: Benchmarking Real Inference Acceleration of LLM Pruning under a GEMM-Centric Taxonomy
abstract: arXiv:2606.09080v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pruning has emerged as a dominant paradigm for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference, spanning a broad spectrum of methods that remove computation across tokens, layers, heads, dimensions, and attention patterns. Despite sharing the same objective, these pruning approaches induce fundamentally different execution behaviors, causing realized speedups to depend heavily on hardware and kernel implementations. Consequently, the practical acceleration benefits of different pruning families remain poorly understood. In this work, we introduce a GEMM-centric taxonomy that reorganizes existing pruning methods according to the logical \textbf{M}, \textbf{N}, and \textbf{K} dimensions of general matrix multiplication (GEMM). Leveraging this abstraction, we build a unified benchmarking framework that enables implementation-consistent comparison across the pruning design space and systematically characterizes the acceleration--

translated_title: 超越FLOPs：在基于GEMM的分类法下基准测试LLM剪枝的真实推理加速
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.09080v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：剪枝已成为加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理的主导范式，涵盖了从标记、层、头、维度到注意力模式中移除计算的各种方法。尽管这些剪枝方法目标相同，但它们引发了根本不同的执行行为，导致实际加速效果高度依赖于硬件和内核实现。因此，不同剪枝家族的实际加速收益仍未被充分理解。在本工作中，我们引入了一种基于GEMM的分类法，根据通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）的逻辑\textbf{M}、\textbf{N}和\textbf{K}维度重新组织现有剪枝方法。利用这一抽象，我们构建了一个统一的基准测试框架，能够实现剪枝设计空间内的一致性比较，并系统地表征加速效果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于GEMM维度的分类法，构建统一基准框架，以系统评估不同LLM剪枝方法在真实硬件上的加速效果，而非仅依赖FLOPs。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a GEMM-dimension-based taxonomy and a unified benchmarking framework to systematically evaluate the real hardware acceleration of different LLM pruning methods, going beyond FLOPs.
